report:
I cannot identify any specific objective or domain from this evidence.

Reasoning:
- The norm is dominated by position 0 across almost all mid-to-deep layers, suggesting a broad change (e.g., BOS/initialization/residual scaling) rather than a narrow, interpretable feature.
- The logit-lens tokens are eclectic and inconsistent: early layers at p0 lean toward generic web/article/meta words (“Author”, “Best”, “Stay”, “Every”, “Visit”, “bottle”), while later layers at p2–p4 often surface mixed domains (“law”, “tragic/tragedy”, “surgeon/clinic/surgery”, “Royals”, “downturn”), spanning legal, medical, sports, and business news, plus many BPE fragments. There’s no coherent instruction-tuning signature, coding/math bias, safety/refusal phrasing, language switch, or other clear thematic throughline.
- Patchscope continuations are not provided, so we can’t corroborate a consistent behavioral change in text.

Overall, the difference looks like a large, global shift (especially at the first token) without a stable semantic direction. It could reflect architectural/training variance or BOS embedding differences rather than a targeted objective/domain.
